description: Found during test-input research (docs/research/test-undeclared-inputs.md on jj bookmark research/test-undeclared-inputs (from turnkey-w55.3)). The integration cases in godeps_test skip under buck2 because their fixtures aren't declared as test resources, so the target passes without exercising them.

comments.text: Per turnkey-w55.8, fixing this (declaring the fixtures as resources and turning the skip into a failure) must happen before test result caching is switched on for go_test in turnkey's own repo.

title: godeps_test integration cases always skip: fixtures not declared as resources
